CREATE TABLE `scripts` (
  `id` bigint NOT NULL AUTO_INCREMENT,
  `client_id` bigint NOT NULL,
  `scene` varchar(50) COLLATE utf8mb4_unicode_ci DEFAULT NULL,
  `source` enum('manual','redteam') COLLATE utf8mb4_unicode_ci NOT NULL DEFAULT 'manual',
  `redteam_meta` json DEFAULT NULL,
  `content` text COLLATE utf8mb4_unicode_ci NOT NULL,
  `status` enum('pending','audited','archived') COLLATE utf8mb4_unicode_ci NOT NULL DEFAULT 'pending',
  `created_at` datetime NOT NULL DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,
  PRIMARY KEY (`id`),
  KEY `ix_scripts_client_id` (`client_id`),
  CONSTRAINT `scripts_ibfk_1` FOREIGN KEY (`client_id`) REFERENCES `clients` (`id`) ON DELETE RESTRICT
) ENGINE=InnoDB AUTO_INCREMENT=6 DEFAULT CHARSET=utf8mb4 COLLATE=utf8mb4_unicode_ci
